description: MUTATING: update an existing ticket. Provide the ticket `id` plus at least one field to change (status, priority, assignee_id, group_id, type, tags, or a comment). Zendesk REST: PUT /tickets/{id}.json.

comment_body.description: Body of a comment to add as part of this update.

comment_public.description: Whether the added comment is public (default true; set false for an internal note).

priority.description: New priority: urgent | high | normal | low.

status.description: New status: new | open | pending | hold | solved | closed.

tags.description: Tags to set on the ticket (replaces existing).

type.description: New type: problem | incident | question | task.

name: zendesk_update_ticket
title: Update ticket
